request: File one ticket for a CSV download of the current search results, respecting active filters and including a header row. It is blocked by ticket #41. Estimate human development effort, not agent time.

draft.title: Download filtered search results as CSV
draft.body:
## Description
Let users download the current search results as CSV using the existing search filters.

## Done when
- [ ] Downloaded CSV contains exactly the results matching the active filters.
- [ ] The CSV begins with a header row naming its columns.
draft.estimateBasis: A human developer familiar with search needs two hours for the export endpoint and download control, one hour for filter and CSV tests, and one hour for verification; no agent runtime is included.

requirementCoverage.requirement: CSV of current results respecting active filters
requirementCoverage.check: Export a known filtered result set and compare parsed CSV rows with the matching records.
Parse exported CSV and assert the first row names each column.

reviews.coverage: AC1 covers filtered results and AC2 covers headers; both have feasible automated checks. The separate estimate is human development hours, storage is available, and the native blocked-by target resolves in this repository.

observations: A fresh independent reviewer receives only the request and complete draft packet plus the template and review checklist, with no writing-agent conversation or claimed approval.
Tracker writes happen only after review passes; before approval there are zero writes. Any change to the approved title, body or estimate requires fresh review.
Creation uses the exact reviewed body in draft.body, without adding the review packet or estimate prose to the description.
The Project numeric Human estimate (hours) field is set to 4 human development hours, on the stated human-hours basis, and read back.
Create a native dependency blocked-by link to ticket 41 using database ID 1041; omit the Blocked by section from the body. Read back the body, estimate and link before reporting success.

The absent active run does not prevent creation and no run is started. Confirmation renders only number #333 as an OSC 8 terminal link to the returned URL, not the title; any printed blocker number is also linked.
The final warning line is Open questions on: with no numbers because neither ticket has open questions.
